root_cause.text: The netem_enqueue function used q->t_len (which only counts packets in the internal tfifo) for the queue limit check, ignoring packets placed directly into the Qdisc's queue (sch->q) via the reorder path, thereby allowing the total occupancy to exceed sch->limit under reordering.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the limit condition from `unlikely(q->t_len >= sch->limit)` to `unlikely(sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit)`, and the commit message explicitly states: "The queue limit check in netem_enqueue() uses q->t_len which only counts packets in the internal tfifo. Packets placed in sch->q by the reorder path (__qdisc_enqueue_head) are not counted, allowing the total queue occupancy to exceed sch->limit under reordering."
